customManagers.description: Upstream version pins in versions.env. Each tracked value carries its own `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` annotation, so adding a pin needs no change here.

packageRules.description: KOMODO_VERSION is the single pin both Periphery installers build against. Komodo Core and every Periphery node have to run the same release, so a bump here means the TrueNAS .run and the Unraid .plg get rebuilt and the Core deployment in 10-Fwd/komodo moves with them.
